Job Description

About the role

Our Procurement is organized in a global matrix with our CPO based in Germany. We are an international team equipped with many years of solid industry knowledge and you will find it easy to integrate in our team if you identify with our working principles: take ownership, drive and execute consistently, act SMARTly, and enjoy what you do. 

If you are a creative mind and enjoy shaping system landscapes, while focusing on process compliance and workability, you should join our team as (Sr.) Manager – Procurement Digitalization (m/f/d).

What you will do

- Transfer procurement processes into digital solutions
- Define global standardized procurement processes and translate such into system requirements
- Realize procurement digitalization projects and initiatives by defining short-, mid- and long-term milestones and deliverables
- Define future-ready and integrated processes, systems and AI-driven automation across different procurement categories
- Drive complex, cross-functional system initiatives and projects and ensure effective stakeholder communication
- Focus on value delivery, ensuring system and process transformation initiatives drive measurable improvements 
- Apply project management skills and change management according to various stakeholder needs (including senior management) 
- Cooperate cross-functionally with global IT and Sourcing teams and jointly ensure system enhancement projects while balancing effort vs. benefit  
- Collaborate with a global team of system & process enthusiasts and regularly engage with a global P2P manager network  
- Prepare and lead global management steering meetings for decision propositions  
- Make informed decisions in complex environments, balancing business needs and technical feasibility 

What you will need

- University degree in IT, business administration, management, supply chain or related subject
- Minimum 7 years of relevant work experience in an international environment
- Proven track record in procurement digitalization and process standardization
- Strong understanding of system implementations and system architecture 
- Experience with piloting, implementing and scaling AI-driven use cases for sourcing automation 
- Deep understanding of end-to-end procurement processes and integrated system landscape
- Strong understanding of data structure, data flows and data governance 
- Ability to translate processes into effective system requirements 
- Experience in leading global project teams  
- Strong communication and change management skills with various stakeholders incl. top management  
- Ability to prioritize and work independently on multiple activities simultaneously 
- Be highly adaptable to dynamic environment with self-starter attitude  
- Strive to drive, are very structured and organized  
- A curious, enthusiastic, driven and determined character, embracing change and aiming for innovation and out of the box thinking  
- Problem-solving mindset  
- Solid presentation skills  
- Excellent English-speaking skills 
- Willingness to travel occasionally (~ 5-10%)

jobs.occupation: Sr. Product Application Engineer (m/f/d) - SiC (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Abut the role

As a Senior Product Application Engineer (m/f/d), you will work on developing and validating advanced SiC-based solutions, turning cutting-edge semiconductor technology into real-world applications. You will collaborate with global teams, support customers, and help drive new products to market, combining hands-on engineering with strong application insight.

What you will do

- Design power electronics platforms using SiC technologies
- Run and analyze testing and validation of power systems
- Build demo systems and present solutions to customers
- Support product go-to-market and customer design-in activities
- Create and deliver technical presentations, training, and webinars
- Help shape next-generation semiconductor performance through application insights
- Support device testing, characterization, and modelling
- Collaborate with internal teams, partners, and universities
- Work in a global, multicultural team

What you will bring

- Masters’s degree or preferably PhD in Power Electronics or Electrical Engineering
- Minimum 3 years of relevant experience with power applications (focus SiC), depending on educational credentials.
- Strong experience in hardware design for SiC, GaN, and IGBT applications
- Knowledge of thermal/mechanical design, gate driving, and inductance optimization
- Skilled in measurements, testing, and high-voltage lab environments
- Solid experience with PCB design, simulation, and power module design
- Able to connect device physics, converter design, and customer needs
- Good communication skills; fluent in English (German is a plus)
- Hands-on approach and willingness to travel occasionally

About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support our team Customs, Airbus Aerostructures is looking for a

Customs Manager (d/f/m)

In this role, you will support the strategic alignment of our customs processes and systems, ensuring the seamless flow of our internal and external international supply chain as we pioneer the future of sustainable aerospace. Join our Customs team to navigate the complexities of global trade and play a key role in optimizing our customs landscape to drive operational excellence.

Your location

You will be working at the largest German production site for commercial aircrafts situated in Hamburg (the position can also be based in Bremen or Augsburg). Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras : Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave; work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Customs Strategy & Compliance:

- Ensure compliant customs processes and serve as the primary customs contact for Airbus Aerostructures GmbH.
- Coordinate customs activities across all Airbus Aerostructures GmbH locations, maintaining alignment with customs authorities.
- Coordinate the company internal interdependencies and foster the customs network.
- Perform internal customs audits, manage quarterly accounting, and lead negotiations regarding customs permits and processes.
- Initiate customs projects for cost optimization and manage risks and opportunities in coordination with Risk Management.

Customs Systems & Data Management:

- Oversee the development, implementation, and optimization of the customs system (SAP-GTS) at Airbus Aerostructures GmbH, including managing system changes and user testing.
- Generate and report customs statistics and KPIs for Airbus Aerostructures GmbH, Airbus, and customs authorities.

Operational Control & Advisory:

- Control operational customs areas, manage external customs agents, and ensure contractual compliance.
- Conduct training for staff on customs regulations and provide guidance to departments such as Purchasing and Logistics.

Your Profile

- Education: Bachelor’s or Diploma degree in Business, Procurement, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or Commercial Apprenticeship with additional relevant qualification.
- Experience: Several years of relevant professional experience in customs and foreign trade.
- Technical Skills: Proficiency in SAP (ideally the GTS module) and Google G-Suite.
- Languages: Professional proficiency in English (minimum C1 level) and native or bilingual proficiency in German (C2 level).
- Soft Skills: Strong communication, conflict-management, and teamwork skills, with an autonomous and reliable work style.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Internship Business Management Support (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support our operations team, Airbus Operations is looking for an

Intern (d/f/m) for Business Management Support

We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly organized, and motivated Business Management Support Intern (d/f/m) to join our operations team. In this role, you will work closely with Airframe Project Managers (APMs) & Offer Managers (OMs), to support project definition, milestone execution, offer management, and financial tracking. This internship offers hands-on experience in corporate project management frameworks, financial planning (DBF), and operational execution.

- Location: Hamburg
- Start: as soon as possible
- Duration: 6 to 9 months (this will be a combination of a mandatory internship of 6 months and a voluntary internship of 3 months as a maximum)

Your location: Hamburg Finkenwerder

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Are you wondering how you actually get from university to Airbus? Your working student position is at the Finkenwerder plant and you can take the ferry from Teufelsbrück to the Airbus ferry terminal and back to the university in the morning and at noon. Alternatively, you can take the ferry to Finkenwerder and then ride your bike for about another 15 minutes to the main entrance.

Your benefits

- Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime) and EUR 750 gross/monthly salary.
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Direct Exposure: Practical experience with industry-standard project management methodologies and governance processes
- Financial Insight: Hands-on involvement in project-level financial tracking and corporate financial alignment
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Direct interaction with key stakeholders across project management, operations, and commercial offer teams.
- Mentorship: Professional development support and continuous guidance from experienced operations managers and project leads.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Business & Project Management Support:

- Support Airframe Project Managers (APMs) in defining project scopes, objectives, and deliverables with sufficient detail.
- Track project progress against established timelines and key performance indicators (KPIs).
- Assist APMs in planning, coordinating, and executing uPDP milestones.

Offer Management & Administrative Support:

- Collaborate with Offer Managers (OMs) to gather, organize, and validate inputs required for commercial offers.
- Perform administrative tracking of new offer inflow requests to ensure timely processing and routing.
- Maintain central records and dashboards for incoming business inquiries and project proposals.

Financial & Performance Tracking:

- Support the Upgrade team in establishing and monitoring project-level financial trackers.
- Monitor budget vs. actuals, variance analysis, and expenditure trends across active projects.
- Maintain alignment between project-level financial tracking .

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student d/f/m) in the area of Business Administration, Business Management, Project Management, Finance, Industrial Engineering, or an equivalent field of study.
- Fluent in German and English.
- Proficiency in Google tools (sheets, slides, docs)
- Advanced Google sheets skills (data organization, lookup formulas, basic financial modeling) preferred.
- Familiarity with project management tools or ERP systems (e.g., SAP) is a plus.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

About the job

The DHAM Factory IT Manager is responsible for the delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of all IT services supporting the Hamburg manufacturing site. The role leads manufacturing IT, factory digitalization, infrastructure, workplace services, and end-user support, ensuring reliable, secure, and efficient IT services for a 24/7 semiconductor manufacturing environment.

This is your new job

Factory IT Leadership

- Lead all IT activities supporting the Hamburg manufacturing site and act as the primary IT partner for site leadership, Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, and Facilities.
- Define and execute the site IT roadmap aligned with business and manufacturing objectives

Manufacturing Systems & Factory Digitalization

- Own the operational performance and continuous improvement of Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), CIM, SPC, APC, and related manufacturing applications.
- Lead lifecycle management, upgrades, and modernization of manufacturing systems.
- Drive factory automation, equipment integration, robotics, and smart manufacturing initiatives.
- Partner with Manufacturing and Engineering teams to deliver Industry 4.0, analytics, AI, and digital transformation initiatives

Infrastructure & Workplace Services

- Ensure reliable operation of networks, servers, storage, workplace technologies, and end-user support services.
- Maintain high availability of IT services supporting 24/7 factory operations

Service Management, Security & Compliance

- Drive incident, problem, change, and service management processes.
- Ensure compliance with cybersecurity, audit, business continuity, and disaster recovery requirements.

Leadership & Vendor Management

- Lead and develop the local Factory IT team and manage external service providers.
- Foster a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and cross-functional collaboration.
- Coordinate resource planning and prioritization across internal team and external partners for projects and business support.
- Manage IT staffing budget and vendor spend in line with overall Factory IT budget.

What you will need

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline
- Minimum 7 years of relevant leadership experience in Manufacturing IT, Factory IT, or industrial environments
- Strong knowledge of MES, CIM, factory automation, equipment integration, and manufacturing operations.
- Solid understanding of IT infrastructure, workplace services, networks, servers, and service management.
- Experience supporting business-critical 24/7 operations.
- Strong stakeholder management, vendor management, and communication skills
- Knowledge of Industry 4.0, Smart Factory, AI/Analytics, and OT/IT integration.
- ITIL or equivalent service management certification
- Fluency in English and German language (spoken and written)

The (Sr.) Quality Assurance Engineer is responsible for applying quality tools, methods, and judgement to support manufacturing operations and ensure product and process compliance. 

The role operates with increasing independence and responsibility, progressing from execution of defined quality activities to ownership of complex investigations, decision-ready analysis, and technical leadership within an area of project. 

This is your new role

- Support and drive manufacturing quality activities within assigned areas or processes. 
- Apply quality tools and methodologies (e.g. SPC, MSA, RCA, 8D) to investigate non-conformance and deviations. 
- Analyse quality and process data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities. 
- Support and participate in audits, reviews, and change activities. 
- Review and support risk assessments, containment actions, and corrective actions. 
- Ensure compliance with defined quality procedures, standards, and safety requirements. 
- Support customer, assembly, and internal quality complaints within assigned scope. 
- Participate in / lead MRBs and support disposition of non-conforming material. 
- Support change control activities (QCM) by reviewing risk, data, and quality impact. 
- Liaise with BG, Back End and Front End teams to ensure quality alignment. 
- Support preparation of quality data, responses, and correspondence for internal and external stakeholders. 

This is you

- Bachelor's or master’s in engineering, manufacturing, science or quality. 
- Minimum 3 years of technical quality experience in semiconductors, electronics or high demanding industry depending on educational credentials
- Experience in (automotive) manufacturing processes
- Practical application of quality tools and problem-solving methods (SPC, 8D, 6 Sigma, Shainin, etc.)
- Proficient use of data analysis and reporting tools
- Clear written and verbal communicator in English and German, suitable for technical and cross-functional audiences
- Good planning and organisational skills
- (Desirable) Qualified Internal Auditor (VDA 6.3 / IATF 16949)

CSL Plasma is one of the world's largest human plasma production companies for the manufacture of highly effective coagulation and immunoglobulin products.

For our Quality Assurance Department in Göttingen we are looking for a

GxP-Auditor (m/f/d) with excellent language skills in EN/DE PLUS Italian OR French

(full-time / permanent)

Performance of qualification audits in the respective national language (EN/IT/FR/DE) in the EMEA region at plasma suppliers / service providers according to GxP and DIN ISO and evaluating the audit results
Performance of risk analyses and evaluation of the impact on the qualification status of the plasma supplier / service provider; evaluation of corrective / preventive measures
Review implementation and compliance with regulations and CSL quality requirements for all facilities to be audited
Assist in further development of the established audit systems
Assist in the creation and editing of standard operating procedures
Update various work lists to provide metrics up-to-date provision of key performance indicators
Electronic acquisition and processing of non-conformance reports
Participate in the implementation of trainings and workshops

Successfully completed vocational training or completed bachelor's degree in public health, natural sciences or similar area
2 - 3 years of professional experience as an auditor preferred but also career changers are welcome
Excellent language skills in Italian or French plus English and German (business fluent)
Willingness to travel intensively with a high degree of flexibility
Sound knowledge of quality management and GxP/DIN ISO area as well as audit/inspection experience preferable
Analytical and solution-oriented thinking skills as well as structured and independent working style
Ability to assess and interpret complex regulations
Ability to work in a team and to handle disputes as well as strong personal and social skills
Confident handling of MS Office standard software

Opportunities for personal and professional development e. g. further training as GxP-Auditor
A highly varying as well as demanding and responsible area of work
Pleasant working atmosphere in an international, dynamic, and high-performance team

Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

As Ideation Manager Life Science you will play a key role in shaping the future innovation pipeline by identifying emerging growth opportunities while driving an effective and customer-centric ideation and opportunity development process. Leveraging customer, market, technology, and business insights, you will lead the Process Solutions ideation framework, methodologies and governance to ensure a consistent flow of strategically aligned opportunities into the innovation portfolio.

Working closely with stakeholders across Business Franchises, R&D, Marketing, Strategy, Commercial, customers, and external partners, you will foster a collaborative innovation ecosystem, accelerate co-ideation, and help shape the future innovation of Process Solutions.

This role can be based in Darmstadt, Germany or Bedford / Burlington, USA.

Key responsibilities:

- Innovation Roadmapping
- Partner with Business franchises, customers and other key stakeholders to translate customer, market, technology, and business insights into strategic innovation themes and roadmaps
- Identify future growth opportunities and shape a robust innovation opportunity pipeline
- Ideation Excellence
- Own and continuously improve the Process Solutions ideation framework, methodologies and governance
- Lead the identification, evaluation & prioritization, and transition of innovation opportunities into the innovation portfolio pipeline – aligned with strategic objectives and a clear focus on customer-centricity
- Collaboration & Co-Ideation
- Build and nurture relationships with stakeholders across the organization, customers and external partners to create a collaborative innovation ecosystem that strengthens the PS innovation pipeline
- Facilitate co-ideation activities that transform promising ideas into actionable innovation concepts
- Champion a customer-centric ideation mindset by promoting best practices, methodologies, tools, and capability building

Who you are:

- BS degree in life sciences, chemistry, engineering, business, or a related field with ~7-12 years of relevant experience, or MS with ~>5 years of relevant experience
- Proven experience in innovation / ideation management, methodologies and tools
- Proactive and hands-on self-starter with the ability to uncover insights, identify opportunities, and mobilize stakeholders to translate them into innovation opportunities
- Strong analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data, insights, and AI-enabled tools to support innovation discovery and decision-making
- Excellent communicat ion and senior stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence and drive results across a matrix organization
- Ideally strong understanding of the Process Solutions business, customer needs, market trends, competitive intelligence and emerging technologies
- Customer-facing experiences are a plus
- Fluent in English; proficiency in German is a plus

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.employer_name: Proteome Sciences R&D GmbH & Co KG
jobs.description:
Proteome Sciences plc (www.proteomics.com) is a global leader in applied proteomics with scientific operations based in Frankfurt am Main (Germany) and San Diego (CA, USA). We partner with innovative companies and academic research groups and offer high sensitivity, proprietary technologies for protein and peptide biomarker discovery, validation and assay development.

We are looking for an exceptionally qualified and highly motivated
Senior Mass Spectrometry Specialist (m/f/d)
to join our Mass Spectrometry team based on our ISO9001:2015 certified facility at Proteome Sciences R&D GmbH &Co. KG in Frankfurt am Main.

In this senior role, you will serve as the core technical anchor and operational subject matter expert for our Mass Spectrometry laboratory. You will combine deep technical expertise in LC-MS instrumentation and quantitative proteomics with strong project management, workflow optimization, and technical coordination responsibilities, driving technical excellence across client projects.
Independent operation, calibration, routine maintenance, and advanced troubleshooting of mass spectrometry and liquid chromatography (nano-LC) equipment.
Development, optimization, and execution of quantitative LC-MS methods (including TMT, DIA, DDA, and targeted studies) for client projects and R&D.
Technical oversight of project execution, capacity planning, and resource management in interaction with other teams to ensure timely delivery within budget.
Diligent tracking and initial quality control of MS raw data in close interaction with the Bioinformatics and wet-lab team.
Technical consulting and contribution to client communications, including project proposals, data presentations, and technical reports.
Guidance and technical support for laboratory personnel to maintain high operational standards and best laboratory practices.
Ensuring strict compliance of MS procedures with ISO9001:2015 and GCLP requirements.

Ph.D. with 2-5 years of professional, preferably industrial or CRO background, operating LC-MS systems in a proteomics environment.
Strong hands-on experience and deep technical knowledge of nano LC and MS applied to peptides and proteins, including advanced instrument operation and troubleshooting.
Solid proficiency with quantitative MS techniques (e.g., TMT, DIA, DDA, PRM).
Expert-level knowledge of proteomic data processing software (e.g., Proteome Discoverer, DIA-NN, Skyline)
Robust project coordination, time management, and organizational skills.
Excellent technical documentation skills and readiness to contribute to client reports and presentations.
Clear and proficient communication in written and spoken English.

Advantageous for the role:

First exposure to technical leadership, mentoring junior team members, or managing project workflows.
Working knowledge or fluency in German.
Familiarity with quality management requirements (ISO 9001, GxP).
Practical knowledge of programming and/or scripting tools such as Python and R.

A high-impact technical role at a market leading company in applied proteomics and biomarker discovery.
Challenging projects in collaboration with international pharma, biotech, and academic leaders.
A friendly, welcoming working atmosphere and support for professional development.

Helmholtz-Zentrum HereonThe Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon conducts cutting-edge international research for a changing world: Around 1,000 employees contribute to the tackling of climate change, the sustainable use of the world's coastal systems and the resource-compatible enhancement of the quality of life. From fundamental research to practical applications, the interdisciplinary research spectrum covers a unique range.

Institute of Metallic Biomaterials
In the Institute of Metallic Biomaterials new titanium and magnesium based implant materials for regenerative medicine are developed, produced and characterized. Researchers investigate the factors influencing the process chain and properties. In addition, the interaction of material and tissue is studied in the laboratory and at the synchrotron.

Postdoctoral Researcher - Agentic Correlative Image Analysis for BlueMaterials

JobID: 1058 - 2026/MB 3
Location: Rostock
Application deadline: 23 September, 2026

Join the Cluster of Excellence "BlueMat: Water-Driven Materials" ( www.tuhh.de/bluemat ) and collaborate with a dynamic, interdisciplinary team that combines science, sustainability, and technology to create a better future. Help shape the next generation of sustainable materials inspired by nature's most powerful resource: water.

For the Institute of Metallic Biomaterials, Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon for as soon as possible, we are looking for a Postdoctoral Researcher - Agentic Correlative Image Analysis for BlueMaterials. In principle, the full time position (39 h/week) is also sharable. The position is fixed-term until 31 August 2029 and located in Rostock.

Equal opportunity is an important part of our personnel policy. We would therefore strongly encourage qualified women to apply for the position.

The BlueMat project 'Agentic correlative image analysis for BlueMaterials', bridges the different imaging and characterization techniques developed within the cross-area imaging and gives support to all researchers in the cluster of excellence to retrieve the highest quality information from image data. The project focusses on implementing an agentic framework for automation of correlative imaging and the corresponding image analysis in particular. By implementing LLM-driven agents that plan the analysis workflow, call established image-analysis modules and judge their own output, you will streamline image processing efforts and enable the elucidation of specific mechanisms of water-material interactions.

design and implement the agentic framework including task planning, tool use and function calling, and self-evaluation loops that orchestrate existing image-analysis modules
build a natural-language interface so BlueMat researchers can run correlative analyses without writing code
automate including image registration and enabling automated extraction of morphological features (e.g., porosity, tortuosity, connectivity) and fluid flow characteristics from 2D and 3D images resulting from magnetic resonance, X-ray and electron images
integration of motion analysis and digital volume correlation
processing of images in preparation for image-based modelling
individual support for researchers across BlueMat in solving image analysis challenges, especially segmentation and quantitative extraction

PhD in computer science, physics, materials science, applied mathematics or a related field
experience in building LLM-based agent systems
strong background in image processing and analysis, including deep learning
experience with correlative imaging workflows and 2D/3D registration techniques
strong programming skills in Python and/or C/C++
ability to work independently and collaboratively in an interdisciplinary environment
excellent communication skills in English
proven project management skills are highly desirable
willingness to travel regularly between Rostock and Hamburg (DESY)

Content-related enquiries regarding this position can be directed to Prof. Dr....

Your Role

Are you ready to shape the future of Data & AI?

Join our team as an AI Engineer   and play a key role within our Data & AI Organization (MDAO) - a highly engaged team of data enthusiasts, engineers, and AI specialists. Our mission is to design, build, and run analytics solutions that deliver actionable insights to address business challenges and provide strategic data products to our partners across the Enabling Functions, including Finance, HR, Procurement, Legal, and many more.
